document_title: AI-Driven Sentiment Analysis for Bitcoin Market Trends: A Predictive Approach to Crypto Volatility
summary: Academic study proposing an AI-driven sentiment analysis framework using Twitter, Reddit, and financial news (2019–2024) to predict Bitcoin price volatility; employs VADER and BERT for sentiment labeling and evaluates Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and SVM classifiers, with SVM showing highest accuracy. No trading signals or real-time market events are generated.

events.title: Bitcoin volatility driven by supply scarcity, sentiment, liquidity, regulation, and macro events
events.body: Das et al. (2025) identify Bitcoin's 21 million capped supply as a scarcity factor, with market sentiment, liquidity, regulatory actions, and macroeconomic events (interest rate changes, inflation reports) as key volatility drivers.
evidence: Das et al. (2025) found that bitcoin's volatility has several different causes related to its capped supply, market sentiment, liquidity, regulations, and macroeconomic events.

events.title: Reddit sentiment correlates with Bitcoin price movements
events.body: Jui et al. (2025) show that Reddit sentiment scores—including crypto-specific terms like 'HODL' and 'FUD'—correspond to changes in Bitcoin price.
evidence: Reddit sentiment scores corresponded to the change in price of Bitcoin.

events.title: Negative Bitcoin tweets reveal fear of scams and market manipulation
events.body: Word cloud analysis of negative Bitcoin tweets shows dominant terms like 'scam,' 'pump,' 'dump,' and 'sell,' indicating community distrust and concerns about market manipulation.
evidence: Negative tweets feature terms 'scam,' 'pump,' 'dump,' reflecting distrust in Bitcoin as an investment.

events.title: Positive Bitcoin tweets reflect investor optimism and community support
events.body: Positive sentiment tweets highlight recurring terms like 'buy,' 'value,' 'profit,' and 'support,' signaling optimism and community encouragement toward Bitcoin.
evidence: Positive tweets emphasize 'buy,' 'value,' 'profit,' indicating investment optimism.

evidence: Study covers 2019–2024 sentiment data from Twitter, Reddit, Bloomberg, CoinDesk, Reuters.
Sentiment labeled using VADER and fine-tuned BERT models.
ML models tested: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM (SVM most accurate).
Features include sentiment scores, tweet/Reddit volume, news sentiment, BTC price, trading volume, realized volatility, BVOL, moving averages.
EDA includes word clouds revealing scam fears in negative tweets and buy/value optimism in positive tweets.
